source_authority.ownership: s_pot/r_pot/m_pot are distinct potential biomass/rate/management state, while DVS/TSUM/anthesis are shared global phenology advanced by the actual branch only.
source_authority.timing: potential update executes before actual; rejected transaction must advance neither.

semantics: Potential rate-state view is materialized using actual phenology plus shadow biomass.
Potential shadow can diverge in WRT/LAI/organ biomass without mutating actual state.
Existing assimilation routine retains the default actual RELMF behavior; an optional explicit override supports potential SWPOTRELMF policy without duplicating assimilation physics.
SWPOTRELMF=2 can pass RELMF; other potential modes can pass 1.0.
The shared one-day rate packet now exposes trial-only gross_root_growth_rate, populated from source GRRT before root death; accepted state still uses root_net_growth_rate.

Potential daily wrapper runs the existing production prepare/rate/structural equations with RELTR=1 and explicit potential RELMF policy, then absorbs only biomass/reference carryover and discards temporary phenology changes.

Daily shadow wrapper runs the same classic assimilation/rate/structural modules with RELTR=1 and explicit potential RELMF policy, then discards temporary DVS/TSUM/anthesis changes and accepts only potential biomass/reference continuation.
The shared rate packet now exposes gross_root_growth_rate as trial-only source GRRT; potential wrapper publishes this as GRRTPOT while WRTPOT is the accepted shadow root biomass.

unlocked_dependencies.SW431-CROP-ROOTGROW: GRRTPOT is now an explicit trial result from the potential shadow daily evaluator; SWRD2 can gate potential extension without deriving gross growth from net biomass change.

transaction.ordering: potential candidate first, actual candidate second
transaction.publication: actual owner, optional potential shadow, GRRT/GRRTPOT carrier and event receipt share one trial state and one kernel commit
transaction.rollback: existing F-WOF38 rollback applies to all together
